Kel

Biography

Kel is a thief and Kir’s travelling companion. She helps the injured stranger in the slave pen, introduces him to the dangers of Suslanger and stays with him through the search for his homeland. Her practical knowledge, irreverence and resourcefulness repeatedly complement Kir’s direct approach. Their partnership gradually becomes a love she is reluctant to express openly. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Love and loss

On Jigran, Kel sees Kir reunited with Tai-Ilara and prepares to leave. She agrees to one last expedition for Tai-Ilara’s belongings and dies during it. Kir’s grief is sharpened by Tai-Ilara’s indifference. A later conversation with Tui-Len offers a possible way to restore a loved one through the three pieces of the Rod of Life; the offer is a quest, not proof that every playthrough ends with a resurrection. [4, 5, 6]
